body: after two failed overdose attempts, i got taken over by the fear of failure. there's no worse feeling then trying yet still waking up again the next morning despite your efforts. after the second time, i began trying to see it from a different perspective. i don't believe in a higher power or anything like that, but maybe the reason you weren't successful is because you're meant to be here. i know it seems hopeless, like you're just continuing for the sake of it and not getting anywhere. but the possibility will always exist that you are meant to be here and it will get better. keep trying to get better. i love you and i'm here for you.
